metadata.source_page_title: Bosch-branded Mobile Apps - Mobile apps - Bosch Digital Design System

topic_summary.one_sentence: Bosch-branded mobile apps are mobile apps built only with Bosch UI Kit elements, Mobile Foundations, and Patterns, deliberately avoiding native UI elements to create a coherent Bosch brand experience.
topic_summary.purpose: Define what qualifies as a Bosch-branded mobile app and when this approach should be used.
topic_summary.core_principle: Use Bosch design-system resources consistently and avoid native UI elements when the goal is a clear, cross-platform Bosch-branded experience.

definition.name: Bosch-branded mobile app
definition.description: A mobile app that uses only elements from the Bosch UI Kit in combination with Mobile Foundations and Patterns.

exclusion_rule.rationale: Excluding native UI elements helps Bosch-branded apps present a clear and coherent design that puts the Bosch brand at the forefront.

recommended_when: The app can be used on all types of devices.
The app is part of a cross-platform solution.
The app exists alongside other digital touchpoints such as websites or eShops.
A consistent user experience across platforms is a key goal.
not_primary_choice_when: The app needs to use native mobile elements as a design or platform requirement.

alternative_guidance.reason_to_use: Use this guidance for mobile apps that use native elements.

design_dependencies.name: Bosch UI Kit
design_dependencies.role: Primary component and UI element source for Bosch-branded mobile apps.

design_dependencies.name: Mobile Foundations
design_dependencies.role: Foundation-level mobile design guidance used together with the Bosch UI Kit.

design_dependencies.name: Patterns
design_dependencies.role: Mandatory or reusable interaction and layout patterns used in Bosch-branded mobile apps.

feature_requests_and_bug_reports.description: Submit feature requests and bug reports relating to the Digital Design System or the Frontend Kit directly to the digital expert team via Jira.

general_feedback.description: For feedback or questions about designing digital touchpoints, contact the support team. The team can also check design drafts.

ai_usage_notes.decision_rule: If an app must maximize Bosch brand coherence across devices and platforms, classify it as a candidate for the Bosch-branded mobile app approach. If native UI elements are required, route to Native mobile apps guidance.
compliance_checks: Uses Bosch UI Kit elements only.
Supports consistent user experience across cross-platform touchpoints.
